newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq roars at opening, U.S. stocks move higher.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq roars at opening, U.S. stocks move higher.

text.p: U.S. stocks moved higher in the first few minutes of trading on Tuesday, with the Nasdaq Composite surging five points to 1,268.
High technology stocks were boosted by surprising strength in the October book-to-bill ratio.
The Dow industrials rose by a more sudued two points up to 6,258, while the S&P Index was up one at 733.
The long bond was up 15/32 to yield 6.47 percent.
